uncertain.note: The first instance (förfela m:t, ἀποτυγχάνειν) has a mark over α that looks like a grave accent rather than a smooth breathing. It is probably a damaged smooth breathing, so I kept ἀ.
In ἐπὶ τῷ τέλει εἶναί τινος the mark over ι looks like a flat circumflex with no clear breathing. I kept εἶναί.
